checks.lead: Şehzade Mehmed (Ottoman Turkish: شاهزاده محمد; September 1522 – 7 November 1543) was an Ottoman prince, son of Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent and his wife Hürrem Sultan. He served as governor of Manisa until his death in 1543.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
